title: Chapter 542
text:
"What a coincidence. Let me introduce you. This red-haired beauty is called Hella, and beside her is her sister, Aurora." Han Xiao nodded at the two sisters before introducing them to Ames.

Hella walked in front of the two of them and stared straight at Ames, ignoring Han Xiao.

Why is the atmosphere so weird?

Han Xiao's mouth twitched, and he continued with the introduction. "Ahem, this is the Dragon Emperor Ames, the Master of Floating Dragon Island, the Land Ripper, Absolute Strength. I'm temporarily working for her."

"Strongest person in the universe?" Hella narrowed her eyes. This term triggered a nerve in her. "How strong?"

Ames tilted her head, and her crystal-like eyes gave off a hint of pressure. "What do you think?"

Han Xiao coughed and stood between the two of them. He bent down and patted Aurora's head, forcefully changing the topic. "Where did your little bear go?"

Aurora looked at Ames timidly before saying, "It's sleeping at home. Han Xiao, this big sister is so pretty. Is she a big shot?"

She was deliberately changing the topic. Her Esper Ability had already sensed Ames's life force, and she had never seen such strength before. She was like a frightened deer, not daring to get close to Ames.

Aurora understood Hella's strong personality. Her sister was never afraid of any strong person, and there was no such thing as respect in her dictionary. Seeing that her sister's attitude was not good, she could not help but feel anxious. She was afraid that this big shot in the universe would be angry, so she hurriedly cooperated with Han Xiao to change the topic and break the gradually tense atmosphere.

Upon hearing this, Ames shifted her gaze away from Hila and looked at Aurora. The girl's cute face had a shy expression, and Ames' gaze could not help but soften. She smiled at Aurora and said, "Your body is filled with a lively and exuberant aura. I like it very much."

The pervasive pressure dissipated, and Aurora's heart relaxed. She smiled and said, "I also like the smell on Big Sister."

"Big sister." Ames's eyes curved, and her smile was kind. "No one has called me that for many years."

With Aurora's interruption, the atmosphere was no longer tense. Han Xiao secretly let out a sigh of relief. He knew Hella's character too well. She had a bad temper and a bad personality. She didn't care about anyone except for her sister. She lacked respect for the strong, but she still pursued power. If he left her alone, Hella would most likely want to see how strong the "top master of the universe" was. If she were to have a conflict with Ames, she would most likely die.

Ames was easy to get along with. If it were any other super master, they would have been beaten to death on the spot if they dared to offend their dignity. As the old saying went, "Grandmasters can't be humiliated, and those who act pretentious will be struck by lightning."

Although Han Xiao valued Hella's potential, potential was not strength. Hella was much stronger than a few years ago, but in front of Ames, she could still be defeated in half a second. After all, Hella had never left Blue Star, so her experience was limited.

Hella frowned. She wasn't a frog at the bottom of a well who was overconfident. She knew from the beginning that she was no match for her. She was just curious about how strong Han Xiao's boss was and how far she was from that level.

Since this topic was interrupted, Hella gave up on the idea of probing. She looked at Han Xiao and asked, "You left Blue Star for a few years. Have you been working under her?"

Han Xiao touched his chin. "Something like that."

"Aren't you a mercenary?"

Hella was confused. She had always been curious about Han Xiao's experience in the galaxy. Although she had heard Ames' introduction, she did not know the meaning of those titles. She was very curious about how powerful this Ames was and what her background was.

"Well, it's a long story." Han Xiao chuckled. He did not want to talk about embarrassing things so casually.

This time, Ames put her hand on Han Xiao's shoulder and squeezed it lightly. She smiled and said, "Black Star is very capable. I need him very much. He has helped me a lot over the years. He's a reliable person."

Ames still remembered that Han Xiao had joined Floating Dragon Island because his life was threatened. She was afraid that Han Xiao would have some knot in his heart and felt that she had to show that she valued him. She was slightly obsessed with cleanliness, but Han Xiao was not an outsider in her eyes. When she had captured Aesop, she had already treated Han Xiao as one of her own.

"Hmm …" Hella's eyes were like nails. She stared at the hand on Han Xiao's shoulder, and her pupils constricted.

She suddenly remembered the rumors on the streets recently. Her eyes moved back and forth between the two of them with a strange expression.

She did not take it seriously at first, but it seemed that there was indeed such a thing.

Hella focused on Ames' appearance. She was wearing a long dress, and her temperament was noble and graceful. There was a hint of age in her beauty. At first glance, she was not too stunning, but the more she looked, the more beautiful she felt. Be it her temperament, figure, or appearance, they were all excellent.

It was a woman's nature to love beauty. Hella subconsciously compared herself to Ames and felt that she was not as beautiful as her. However, when she lowered her head and looked at her heavy chest, her confidence returned.

Hella glanced at Han Xiao coldly.

Humph, as expected, men are all the same. As long as they go to the outside world, none of them can resist temptation.

Han Xiao was confused.

What the hell? Why is this woman staring at me?

At this time, Aurora broke the silence and asked curiously, "Big sister, why did you come to our planet?"

Ames's expression changed back to a kind smile. "Actually, you guys are also the reason I came to Blue Star. I'm very interested in your Esper Abilities."

Hella's expression changed suddenly. The memory of the Germinal Organization flashed past her eyes. She stood in front of Aurora and said warily, "What do you mean?"

"One controls death, one controls life, and they're sisters. A long time ago, there were people who were extremely similar in the universe. At the end of the exploration era, the appearance of the first Super seemed to have broken through some kind of limit. In the battlefields of various Star Fields, there were Calamity Grades breaking through one after another. Perhaps they had been at a bottleneck for a long time, and the first Super showed them the way. Or perhaps there were other reasons. In any case, Super Grades that had never appeared before kept appearing during that time.

"After the war ended, these first Super Grades were all known by the world and recorded down. They were known as the Primordial Ones in history. Coincidentally, there was a pair of sisters whose Esper Abilities were extremely similar to yours. Thousands of years later, you guys appeared, so I'm very interested in you guys."

Although Ames was lazy, she still had some knowledge about the history of the universe. Coincidentally, they were sisters with similar Esper Abilities. The probability of this coincidence was too shocking. It was probably one in a trillion. After so many years, only this pair had appeared. Paying attention to this kind of small probability event had always been Ames' interest.

However, there were many examples of similar Esper Abilities in history. She did not suspect that Hella and Aurora were related to the Primordial Ones. She just thought that it was a shocking coincidence.

Hella and Aurora were shocked. This was the first time they had heard about the history of the universe.

However, Han Xiao's eyes flickered. As a villager of the Earth Village who had been influenced by all kinds of literary works, after hearing Ames' words, the first thing he thought of was the reincarnation of a powerful being or the possibility of a secret inheritance.

However, thinking back to the storyline of his previous life, Aurora had turned into paste very early on. She did not have any Lucky Halo, Providence Protection, or anything like that. If she was really reincarnated, it would be too tragic.

Han Xiao shook his head helplessly. He felt that he was thinking too much. This was probably just a coincidence after so many years.

"Then, what does Big Sister want to do to us?" Aurora could not help but shrink back.

Hearing this, for a moment, Ames' eyes became distant, as if she had recalled some memories. Then, she calmed down and looked at the two sisters.

"I want to take you as my disciples. Are you willing?"

"Huh?"

Han Xiao, Hella, and Aurora all tilted their heads, as if there were question marks above their heads.

Ames was very interested in the two sisters, and the idea of taking them as her disciples did not come out of nowhere. When she was very young, Aesop had adopted her, and she had always remembered this kindness in her heart. For a long time, her biggest goal was to find Aesop, and this lasted for many years.

Han Xiao found Aesop and fulfilled Ames' long-cherished wish. She untied the knot in her heart, and another idea came into her mind. Ames also wanted to learn from Aesop and try to adopt some children, but she had not found a suitable partner.

When Black Star was a spy, Black Star talked about the two sisters' situation, and Ames paid attention to it. Hella and Aurora's parents died early, and they had great potential. It was a funny coincidence that they met her requirements. She was old enough to be the two sisters' adoptive mother, and she was even old enough to be their grandmother.

However, the two sisters were already adults, and they did not need an adoptive mother. Ames thought about it again and again and decided to take a compromise, which was to take the two sisters as her disciples. It was more acceptable.

Hella and Aurora were stunned. They did not expect Ames to have such a request. They looked at each other and saw the surprise on each other's face.

"Well …" Hella was about to answer when she suddenly thought of something. She touched Aurora's head and asked, "Do you have any opinions?"

She rarely made decisions for Aurora and respected her younger sister's opinion most of the time.

Aurora had a conflicted expression. She did not know Ames, but she felt that she was very close to her. She turned to look at Han Xiao, who was looking at the sky with a 'none of my business' expression, and asked, "Uncle Han, what do you think?"

"Call me big brother." Han Xiao patiently corrected her and said with a helpless tone, "You asked me if I support it. Of course, I support it. She's one of the strongest people in the Shattered Star Ring."

For such a powerful person like Ames to take the initiative to take in a disciple, this was a great opportunity for the two sisters.

Most importantly, Ames is my boss, and I can't do anything in front of her. So, what's the use of asking me? What other answer do I have?

Silly girl. Han Xiaoxin complained.

"Then, I'll listen to you this time." Aurora puffed up her cheeks.

Hella was silent for a while before slowly saying, "I want to know what kind of strength you have. Are you qualified to be our teacher?"

Ames smiled, extended her finger, and pointed at the sky.

Nothing happened.

"What are you doing?"

Hella frowned, but before she could finish, a sound wave came from the sky.

Boom!

In the sky, hundreds of meteors broke through the clouds from different directions and fell at high speed. However, the landing points were exactly the same, flying toward the sanctuary from all directions.

The scene was magnificent, as if the apocalypse had arrived. The players, refugees, and others in the sanctuary all looked up with a dazed expression.

Exclamations resounded through the clouds.

What — what's going on?

Dark-star is attacking again?

Where's Godora's fleet?

Hundreds of flaming meteors streaked across the sky and rapidly approached. There was nowhere to hide. Countless people started to panic. When the meteors got closer, the sharp-eyed people saw the falling objects through the flames of the meteors. In the next moment, these people were frightened to the point of insanity.

These meteors were all Godoran frigates that were waiting for orders in outer space!

Whoosh …

Just when the meteors were a thousand meters above the sanctuary, their destructive momentum came to an abrupt stop. The kinetic energy disappeared without a trace, and the fleet stopped in mid-air.

Immediately after, the other meteors also stopped a thousand meters above the ground. The entire Godora fleet was suspended above the sanctuary.

Godora's fleet outside the atmosphere was all pulled down!

Ames tilted her head and looked at the stunned Hella and Aurora. She smiled and asked, "Do you think I'm qualified now?"

Capturing a spaceship with a force field was a piece of cake for Ames. She was known as the "Land Ripper"!

"Hahaha," Han Xiao took out a cigarette and lit it up. He smiled with the cigarette in his mouth, and his eyes were full of admiration.

This pretentious act was not bad, and it had some of his style. He did not expect Ames to be an expert at acting tough.
